keyboard.interpretation: The final unrestricted runs are slower than the earlier baseline. Immediate same-processor baseline/current pairs do not show a consistent code-related increase, and retain substantial scheduling outliers. These observations establish neither a latency improvement nor a guarantee against a small regression. The engine, hook and event data code hashes are unchanged; protocol.py and keeper.py are the changed measured dependencies. Scope is synthetic engine decisions with a silent host, not physical hook or SendInput latency. All recorded runs are retained.

limits.opt_in_desktop_e2e: Three modules remain skipped by ordinary full selfcheck; no company endpoint or foreground keyboard/mouse automation was enabled.
limits.full_log_diagnostics: The passing full Windows log retains three Error streaming response lines and two Tcl cross-thread interpreter teardown RuntimeWarnings. They are not counted as mutation detections or suppressed from the evidence.
limits.desktop_taskbar: WSL launch prevents the independent taskbar-recovery helper from breaking away. Workspace leaves Explorer visible and explains direct Windows launch; the desktop bar, canvas and launcher remain usable.
limits.canvas_adapters: Live windows, local file/table observations, Edge excerpts and local drafts are implemented. Dedicated Excel range writes, Teams projections and a verified Outlook object adapter remain adapter work.
limits.execution: The durable worker executes one task at a time; waiting releases its slot, and cancellation waits for effect cleanup.
